cause: The muxer cut AAC at reordered video DTS; a continuous next entry began at sample 92160 but a restarted entry began at 96256. Both shared the correct 1024-sample phase; segment packet ownership differed.
fix: Encoded Segmenter assigns leading AAC packets by rational presentation-plan boundaries; copies only moved audio payload, preserves timestamps/sample bytes and leaves copy segmentation unchanged.

checks.scope: Exact packet/sample conservation and rational cut; compact audio payload only.
Independent forward/backward video/AAC splices, init equality, exact intervals and decoded sample count, waveform bound and presentation grid.
